question.text: The standard deviation of a distribution is <math><mn>30.</mn></math> If each observation is increased by <math><mn>5</mn></math>, then the new standard deviation will be

solution.text:
S.D. of a series is unaltered if each observation is increased (or reduced) by the same scalar quantity, S.D. is independent of change of origin.
Hence, S.D. will be the same.
∴ S.D. =30
